meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 收到发布指令后，它会触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流，盯到跑完为止，核对 GitHub release、npm 版本和平台安装包，补写发布说明并发到 Discord 频道。
howto.when: 当你说出 “publish”、“release” 等触发词，并指定 patch、minor、major 或一个具体版本号时，它会接管整个发布流程；没给版本号它会停下来先问你。

say.note: 触发补丁版本发布工作流

howto.what_en: Once you give a release command, it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, follows the run to completion, verifies the GitHub release, npm versions and platform packages, drafts release notes and posts to Discord.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you say “publish”, “release” and similar triggers while naming patch, minor, major or an explicit version; without a version it stops and asks first.
